overloads.semanticRole: Applies a SQL-syntax WHERE-clause formula (evaluated via 4D's built-in SQL engine) to every record of aTable, building a new selection from the records where it evaluates True.

constraints: sqlFormula is only the WHERE-clause fragment of an implicit "SELECT * FROM table WHERE ..." query; aTable supplies the FROM table.
Cannot be used in the context of an external SQL connection; it always connects directly to 4D's integrated SQL engine.
sqlFormula must be a valid SQL-2-compliant boolean search condition (True/False/NULL per the SQL standard); all rows where it evaluates True are included in the new current selection.
sqlFormula can embed references to 4D expressions/variables using the same <> or :MyVar syntax used in the integrated SQL commands or inside Begin SQL/End SQL blocks.
Compatible with the SET QUERY LIMIT and SET QUERY DESTINATION commands, like QUERY BY FORMULA.
Behaves like QUERY BY FORMULA otherwise: it changes aTable's current selection and makes the new selection's first record current.
